subject: Request for review of unexpected processing fee increase
summary: Razorpay applied a 2.30% fee instead of the agreed 1.80% rate across 1,248 transactions after a promotional waiver ended. Reclaim calculated ₹12,450 in excess charges.

subject: Request for review of duplicate refund
summary: A ₹4,200 refund was processed twice against the same payment. Reclaim identified the second refund as an excess debit.
